page.title: Home | Builtechraft
page.description: A private semi-vanilla Minecraft server focused on building, engineering, and community.
page.comparisonDescription: Three ways to modify Minecraft, three different philosophies. We tried all three for years and here is why we chose the option that stays closest to the original game.
page.modsDescription: We use mods and datapacks focused on performance, quality of life, and building tools.
page.roadmapDescription: Explore upcoming expansions, planned maintenance, and server updates.

hero.description: Bringing together the essence of Minecraft and thoughtful enhancements that unite artistic creativity and ingenuity.

welcome.title: What is
welcome.description: Builtechraft is a private survival server for players who enjoy building and bringing their ideas to life, from a small house to megastructures. It runs on Fabric and stays close to the vanilla Minecraft experience, with carefully selected enhancements.

vanilla.title: 🌿 Vanilla+
vanilla.desc: The vanilla experience comes first. Mods and datapacks enhance it without changing the core game.

whitelist.title: Whitelist
whitelist.desc: Access is restricted to keep the community small and active, and to protect the world for the long term.

creative.title: ️ Creative world
creative.desc: Design, test, and plan your builds before bringing them into the survival world.

innovation.title: 🔥 Constant innovation
innovation.desc: We develop projects that bring together building and the potential of datapacks.

categories.title: Explore our website
categories.description: Discover the main sections and find information about the server, its worlds, mods, datapacks, team, and roadmap.

worlds.desc: Explore our survival and creative maps in real time.

mods.desc: Learn about the technical enhancements we use.

history.desc: Explore our beginnings, evolution, and community milestones.

rules.desc: Read the community and fair-play guidelines.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.desc: Find answers about accounts, lag, and gameplay mechanics.

discord.desc: Join Discord for events, support, and conversation.

donate.desc: Your contribution helps us keep the servers running and improving.

worlds.title: Our worlds
worlds.description: Builtechraft has two main worlds: one for survival and another for designing, experimenting, and planning builds before bringing them into the game.

creative.title: Creative world
creative.desc: Try ideas, plan projects, and experiment with blocks before building in survival. Bring your imagination to life here first.

survival.title: Survival world
survival.desc: The server's main world. Projects, exploration, and builds that shape Builtechraft's history all happen here.

mods.title: Mods
mods.subtitle: Forge / Fabric
mods.summary: Powerful modifications installed on your computer. They can change almost any part of the game, but require installation and may alter vanilla mechanics.

plugins.title: Plugins
plugins.subtitle: Spigot / Paper
plugins.summary: Modifications installed only on the server. Players need no extra installation, but technical mechanics such as farms and redstone may be affected.

datapacks.title: Datapacks
datapacks.subtitle: Pure vanilla
datapacks.summary: Files included in the world. They require no installation, preserve vanilla gameplay, and work with Minecraft updates.

modpack.title: Do you enjoy mods?
modpack.description: There is no need to configure everything from scratch. We prepared mod profiles and options that are easy to download and install with our access guide.
modpack.bobbyDescription: We use Bobby to load and view distant chunks smoothly, maintaining good performance even on large maps.

staff.title: Our team
staff.description: Thanks to everyone who contributes to the different areas of this project.

vision.title: A project built for the joy of Minecraft
vision.description: We preserve the essence of Minecraft while building an epic world with enhancements that make the experience comfortable and enjoyable for every kind of player.
